placo.binding: Python loop over C++ QP solver

motion.dataset: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
motion.fixed_pelvis_grounding: lower bilateral foot at zero height each phase
motion.floating_contact_classifier: bilateral endpoint-height order with a 0.005 m overlap band; the lower foot is always support

floating_lateral_support_retarget.method: affine map of pinned canonical-cycle single-support root means to target foot centers

motion.initialization: lowest double-support phase registered to the target rig root; only horizontal capture-frame deltas transfer while the already-grounded foot-height channel is preserved
motion.startup_phase_ramp: quintic smootherstep from zero to nominal cadence
